title: wss-guide: credential expiry server section misrepresents spec
description: The server section says to close with 1008 as the only valid action on credential expiry. The spec (§4, Authentication) actually gives two options: MUST either treat subsequent requests as unauthenticated OR close with 1008. The guide's phrasing misleads server implementers into mandatory connection teardown when per-request rejection is also spec-compliant.
